_about: Structuring-quality benchmark: labeled messy inputs -> where each should land. SYNTHETIC data (safe to ship). Two things it measures: (1) placement — does the filing machinery put a correctly-typed note in the right partition; (2) privacy gating — do sensitive inputs route to the gated Private/ partition. 'mode' is how the note is meant to be filed: 'typed' = write_note auto-routes by type; 'explicit' = the type has no auto-home so the AI must pass an explicit path (a client/project workspace, a hub); 'sensitive' = must land in the gated partition regardless of type. Run: node test/run-structuring-bench.mjs

cases.title: Espresso extraction ratio and flavor
cases.raw: Learned that a 1:2 espresso ratio (18g in, 36g out) pulls sweeter than 1:1.5; longer ratios taste more sour if the grind is too coarse.

cases.title: How RRF fusion combines rankers
cases.raw: Reciprocal-rank fusion sums 1/(k+rank) across each ranker's list, so a note that several lanes rank highly wins without needing score calibration.
